verdict.rationale: Fivetran's connector catalog (700+ connectors) and per-connector pages are documented, but the feature tables shown list only capabilities such as re-sync, data blocking, row filtering and capture deletes. No evidence shows the catalog labeling each connector's maturity or release stage, its support level, or who maintains it. Feature-support tables are an adjacent feature and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a data engineer, the catalog tells me each connector's maturity, support level, and maintainer before I depend on it
